title: Thunder Heroes
note: Action game on the Cave board (CAVE): health, health_p2, time, credits, lives, lives_p2, stage (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cave_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Cave 68000 work RAM from 0x100000 (64 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x60 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL1)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x60 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL2)

lives.note: lives (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Lives PL1)

lives_p2.note: lives of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Lives PL2)

_p1_chr.note: player 1 character (FBNeo cheat database, Select Character PL1)

_p2_chr.note: player 2 or computer character (FBNeo cheat database, Select Character PL2)

stage.note: stage, the value read plus one (FBNeo cheat database, Select Starting Stage)

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)
